data.name: Inferno Loot: Bullet Hell Bound
data.detailed_description:
Inferno Loot: Bullet Hell Bound is a high-octane, top-down action roguelike where every run is a desperate struggle for survival against the legions of hell. Dive into a dark, pixel-art world where your skill, your weapons, and your luck are the only things standing between you and eternal oblivion.

Master the Bullet Hell

Face overwhelming waves of enemies in intense, fast-paced combat. Navigate through a chaotic storm of projectiles while unleashing your own devastating arsenal. Every second counts, and one wrong move could be your last.

Loot, Equip, and Evolve

As you fight through the inferno, discover a vast array of weapons and gear. From rapid-fire submachine guns to mystical scythes, customize your loadout to suit your playstyle. Level up during your run to increase your health, armor, and power, turning your character into an unstoppable force of destruction.

No Two Runs Are Alike

Embrace the challenge of perma-death. Every time you fall, you rise again stronger, learning from your mistakes. With procedural elements and a wide variety of loot combinations, every attempt offers a fresh experience and new tactical possibilities.

Key Features:

  • Intense Roguelike Action: Fight, die, and repeat in a satisfying loop of progression.

  • Deep Loot System: Find and equip powerful weapons like the AK47, M16, and mystical artifacts.

  • Character Progression: Level up your stats mid-run to survive the escalating difficulty.

  • Retro Pixel Aesthetics: Immerse yourself in a beautifully crafted dark fantasy world with vibrant visual effects.

  • Score Attack: Push your skills to the limit and aim for the highest score in the leaderboards.

data.short_description: Face the relentless legions of hell in this fast-paced top-down roguelike. Loot powerful weapons, level up your stats, and survive the bullet hell chaos. How long can you stay alive in the inferno?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD equivalent
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Intel i3 (Intel-based Macs) or Apple M1 (base-level performance)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 5000 / Apple Silicon integrated GPU
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 / M2 (or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon GPU (M1/M2 performance level)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
